name: Bakenohana
source:
When a strange sickness begins affecting the people of Florena, the queen sends you to find answers. The medical team has no solution, and the situation grows tense. 

Investigate the village, survive its dangers, complete puzzles, and reveal what’s behind the outbreak.

[From [url=https://morvenn.itch.io/bakenohana]Itch.io[/url]]
